# Proverbs 15 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 15:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | A-fool spurns [the]-discipline-of his-father, but-one-keeping correction is-prudent. |
| LOGOS | A fool despises his father's instruction, but whoever heeds reproof is prudent. |
| PNEUMA | Only a fool ignores their father's correction. Accepting it is the mark of a smart person. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
